title: Autumnal American Braeburn Apple Salad
description: A refreshing and energizing American dish featuring Braeburn apples, with a balance of bitter and sweet flavors, perfect for the autumn season. This salad is low-fat-friendly and served in a bento box.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, diced Braeburn apples, dried cranberries, crumbled blue cheese, and toasted walnuts.
In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar, honey, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the salad a good toss and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Spoon the salad into a bento box and serve immediately.
To add a glassy-jelly texture, top the salad with a spoonful of quince paste or apple jelly, if desired.
Namul-blanch the salad by briefly submerging the bento box in a large bowl of ice water to stop the cooking process and preserve the colors and textures.
